method.name: Palu head-wise low-rank K/V projection
method.port_boundary: The released wrapper subclasses Qwen2 rather than Qwen3.5. This bounded port applies Palu's per-head SVD axis and square-root singular-value factorization to Qwen3.5 layer-3 K/V projection weights. The upstream helper's unconditional exact-reconstruction assertion is invalid for truncated ranks, so the hash-bound port retains the formula but removes only that assertion. It does not port Palu's attention kernel or rank-search training pipeline.

input.selection: first 256 tokenizer tokens without special tokens
